extras: Relies on private APIs and may conflict with the Outliner plugin.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that lets you turn each list behavior handled by Smart lists (Settings → Editor → Smart lists) on or off individually.
problem: Users cannot granularly control specific list behaviors like indentation or line movement when using Obsidian's Smart Lists feature.

relations.evidence: If you use the Outliner plugin, enable Tab / Shift-Tab and line moving in only one of the two plugins.

summary: Smart List Tweaks allows users to individually control various list behaviors, such as indentation, line movement, and entry creation, overriding or supplementing Obsidian's Smart Lists settings.
